title: Arkret Agent Selector Claim
description: Signed claim binding a controller-scoped native personal agent selector slug to an agent principal DID. It powers @<controller-handle>/<agent_slug> compose-time resolution without making the agent carry a public handle.

controller_subject.description: Controller principal DID that owns the selector namespace.

agent_slug.description: Controller-scoped slug used as the right-hand side of @<controller-handle>/<agent_slug>.

subject.description: Native personal agent principal DID selected by (controller_subject, agent_slug).

issuer.description: DID that signs this selector claim. It is normally controller_subject; a delegated issuer MUST be authorized by controller_subject and bound in source_refs or proof evidence.

issuer_service_id.description: Service DID that served or vouched for this selector claim when distinct from issuer.

visibility.description: Disclosure boundary for selector resolution. Restricted/private claims require audience and requester policy checks before returning subject.

audience.description: Audience binding for restricted selector disclosure, such as a Realm ID, verifier domain, or service DID.

claim_scope.description: Optional scope such as realm_id, organization_id, purpose, allowed_operations, or disclosure policy tags.

source_refs.description: Optional refs to accountability_grant, actor profile, provisioning, delegation, or revocation evidence.
